snippet.title: Stay Whit Him or He'll Eat Your Soul - The Virus Game - ALL ENDINGS
snippet.description:
We download a deleted game...
After starting the game, we meet one of the characters – the Virus, which feeds on the souls of people. Depending on your decisions, you will either become friends with it or die.
